title: agrostis peruviana
intro: Agrostis peruviana, commonly known as Peruvian bentgrass, is a species of grass native to South America. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce pain and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Peruvian bentgrass include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Agrostis peruviana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
